aspect_ratio.description: Optional output aspect ratio. Leave empty to match the first input image.
aspect_ratio.title: Aspect Ratio

enable_prompt_expansion.description: Expand the prompt while preserving its intent and the roles of reference images.
enable_prompt_expansion.title: Enable Prompt Expansion

images.description: Upload 1-10 input images in reference order. Each must be at least 256 pixels per dimension and at most 4 megapixels. Omit aspect_ratio to follow the first image.
images.title: Images

output_format.description: The format of the generated image.
output_format.title: Output Format

prompt.description: Describe the changes. Refer to input images by their order, such as image 1 or image 2.
prompt.title: Prompt

resolution.description: Output resolution tier. Higher tiers cost more; 4K can take several minutes.
resolution.title: Resolution

created_at.description: ISO timestamp of when the request was created (e.g., “2023-04-01T12:34:56.789Z”).

id.description: Unique identifier for the prediction, the ID of the prediction to get.

model.description: Model ID used for the prediction.

outputs.description: Array of generated outputs (empty when status is not completed). Items are usually URL strings, but may be text strings or structured result objects, depending on the model.

status.description: Status of the task: created, processing, completed, or failed.

post.description: Submit a request to run the model and create a prediction.

get.description: Retrieve the current status and result of a prediction.

parameters.description: The ID of the prediction request.
parameters.name: request_id
